_meta.description: Fixed Lunar test path — 8 nodes, 1 fork. Used for engine testing. In production, the engine generates maps procedurally per map_rules.json. This file is the hand-built equivalent for the first playable build.
_meta.path_structure: Launch → Station → Planet → Fork(Asteroid | Derelict) → reconnect → Shipboard → Station(final) → Arrival

nodes.name: Earth Orbital Station Kepler-9
nodes.description: Departure point. The paperwork has been filed.

nodes.name: Waypoint Zeta-4
nodes.description: The last honest station. Fair prices. Genuine concern.

nodes.name: Soil Sample Paradise
nodes.description: Rocky, mineral-rich, profoundly boring. The ship computer approves.

nodes.name: Route Decision
nodes.description: Two paths forward. Both have merit. Neither is ideal.

nodes.name: Dustfield Crossing
nodes.description: Paths converge through a thin nebula. Shipboard events may fire here.

nodes.name: The Last Resort (Branded)
nodes.description: Final station. Premium prices. Mysterious trader in the corner.
